mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.2% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in >45% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST and RSAFS rising together fails to produce positive returns in >50% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 230) trigger aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 230 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll growth exceeding 134,000 persons consistently signals economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in >55% of instances when PAYEMS > 134,000 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 95 indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >45% of instances when INDPRO < 95 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) expansion signal robust economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of GDPC1 and HOUST rising together fails to yield positive returns in >50% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Inflation shock regimes (CPIAUCSL > 230 and FEDFUNDS rise > 0.1% in 1 month) trigger immediate rate hikes that cause equity sell-offs, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 230 and FEDFUNDS rise > 0.1% in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in >45% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 230 and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1% in 1 month over a 3-year rolling window.
